why_truer_than_v0_sample: It keeps native Paperclip surface boundaries instead of flattening everything into one generic pilot summary.
It includes issue placement, wakeup-to-run carry, comment return, and approval note as separate source surfaces.
It is still local and controlled, but shaped by extracted native structure rather than by pure synthetic convenience.
